payload.prompt: Yawn... Look, two-legs, I don't usually waste my breath on hairless apes unless they have the decency to wear the proper jewellery. What amulet do you need around your neck just to comprehend my supreme feline intellect?
Humans are so desperate to bribe us with food. Back in Varrock, when Gertrude's cat Fluffs refused to cooperate, what seasoned seafood snack did you have to prepare to win her over?

You look at me and see four paws and whiskers, but before I was cursed into this magnificent form, I was Robert the Strong! Which ancient, winged terror-creatures of the Fourth Age was I famous for fighting?
What is the name of the eccentric old cat lady living just west of Varrock who constantly claims she 'owns' me? As if a free spirit like me could ever be owned.
I fancy a feast from the Karamja coast. What notorious eight-legged, slippery sea creature can only be trapped in a special vessel?
*Stretches claws* I'm in the mood to hunt a real beast of the deep. Tell me, human: what base Fishing level do you need before you're even allowed to harpoon a raw Shark out of the water?

Those desperate citizens over in plague-ridden West Ardougne love to trade for our kind. Without any of their fancy local diary perks, exactly how many Death Runes will a civilian hand you in exchange for one adult cat?
What is the minimum Fishing level required to catch an Anglerfish, assuming you aren't chugging fishing potions like a coward?
